BillHeading.Sponsors: Senate Early Learning & K-12 Education (originally sponsored by Senators McAuliffe and Litzow)

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school day start times; creating new sections; and providing an expiration date.

BillSectionHeader.P: The legislature acknowledges that students who do not get enough sleep often suffer physical and mental health problems and a decline in academic performance.
(1) The Washington state institute for public policy shall conduct a study of the student achievement outcomes and other related outcomes when schools have later school day start times.

BillSection.P: (2) The institute shall submit a report, in compliance with RCW 43.01.036, to the relevant committees of the legislature by December 1, 2016.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act may be known and cited as the sandman act.
